extracted.intended_audience: typesetters, printers, typographers, book designers and publishers
extracted.subtask_description: A printed/catalog specimen showing typefaces set in a variety of point sizes, variants, and scripts so designers/printers can evaluate and choose type. The page demonstrates fonts (names and variants), multiple point sizes, language scripts, punctuation, and display vs. body text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Label typeface name and variant
rubrics_metrics.description: Each specimen is identified by an explicit typeface name and variant (examples on-page: 'CASLON OLD STYLE', 'LINOTYPE TYPE', 'CENTURY EXPANDED', 'CASLON OLD STYLE ITALIC'). Point-size headings (e.g., 'EIGHT POINT', 'TEN POINT', 'TWELVE POINT') appear alongside the type name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prominently display the typeface name and the specimen's point size/variant next to the sample so users can immediately associate the visual sample with its name and size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide multiple point-size specimens
rubrics_metrics.description: The same text sample is shown repeatedly across a wide range of point sizes (examples include 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 18, 22, 24, 30, 36, 48 points).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show a typeface at many sizes so viewers can evaluate its appearance and legibility from small body text up to large display sizes; include both small-text and display-size examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use representative body text for evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: A continuous paragraph (an excerpt beginning 'When thoughtful Greeks like Polybius saw the fall of Carthage and of Corinth...') is used repeatedly as the standard sample text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a text with a variety of letters, word lengths, punctuation and line breaks (a sensible prose paragraph) so the face's metrics, spacing, and rhythm can be judged realistically in paragraph setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show display capitals and headline forms
rubrics_metrics.description: All-caps display lines such as 'THE FIRST TIME THAT THE GRAND PROSPECT HAD BEEN HELD FORTH' (rendered at multiple sizes) are included alongside paragraph text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include large capitals/headline samples to demonstrate the face's performance in display/headline settings and contrast with body text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate italic, condensed, expanded and other variants
rubrics_metrics.description: Variants and styles are shown and labeled (examples: 'CASLON OLD STYLE ITALIC', 'CONDENSED OLD STYLE', 'CENTURY EXPANDED', 'CASLON OLD STYLE ITALIC', 'OLD STYLE NO. 8 ITALIC').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present each significant stylistic variant (italic, condensed, expanded, bold/black where applicable) so users can compare family breadth and suitability for different uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include multiple scripts and language specimens
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-Latin scripts and language samples are present with headings (examples: 'PORSON GREEK', 'ANTIQUE GREEK', 'INSCRIPTION GREEK', 'HEBREW', 'NESTORIAN SYRIAC', 'ARABIC', 'ETHIOPIC').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specimens for non-Latin scripts with appropriate sizing and line examples to evaluate multilingual typesetting and glyph completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show miscellaneous signs, punctuation and special glyphs
rubrics_metrics.description: A section labeled 'MISCELLANEOUS SIGNS' lists assorted symbols (mathematical signs, punctuation, typographic marks) at different point sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a set of punctuation, special characters, and symbols so users can check the design and spacing of non-alphabetic glyphs important for real-world typesetting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide specimen numbering and catalog identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens and pages are numbered and labeled (examples: 'NO. 31', page numbers and headings like 'specimens of Types in Use').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number specimens and pages to allow easy cross-referencing in a catalog or order/inventory system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify foundry/producer and production method
rubrics_metrics.description: Producer and method labels appear (examples: 'The University of Chicago Press', 'LINOTYPE TYPE', foundry/typeface names like 'Bradley Cext', 'Touraine Old Style').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show the foundry/producer and, where relevant, production technology (e.g., Linotype) to inform purchasing/setting decisions and compatibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate measure, leading, and paragraph setting
rubrics_metrics.description: Paragraph samples show line breaks, measures and leading appropriate to each point size (the same paragraph set at different sizes demonstrates how line length and leading affect readability).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include realistic paragraph settings (line length/measure and leading) at each size to let viewers assess legibility and spacing characteristics, not just isolated letterforms.
